hooks.command: if ! command -v devbox >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'devbox not found on PATH — install: curl -fsSL https://get.jetify.com/devbox/install.sh | bash'; exit 0; fi; [ -f devbox.json ] || exit 0; [ -f package.json ] || exit 0; [ -d node_modules ] && exit 0; devbox run install >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
